title_zh: 找到钥匙后换个存放地方

scenario.label_zh: 寻找钥匙并调整放置习惯
scenario.goal_zh: 根据最后使用情况找到钥匙并商定固定存放位置

context_zh: 室友在家寻找遗失的钥匙，并商定以后放置钥匙的位置。
author: author-phase03-c

sentences.speaker: Willa
sentences.text: I've looked everywhere for my keys. Have you seen them?

sentences.speaker: Devon
sentences.text: You were carrying the washing when you came in. Did you put them on the basket?

sentences.speaker: Willa
sentences.text: No, but I might have left them under the towel on this chair.

sentences.speaker: Devon
sentences.text: There they are. You have a habit of putting things down while your hands are full.

sentences.speaker: Willa
sentences.text: I know. I seem to hide them from myself without meaning to.

sentences.speaker: Devon
sentences.text: Would a small bowl by the door help?

sentences.speaker: Willa
sentences.text: Yes. Let's use the blue one. I'll put the keys there as soon as I come in.
